coverage.frozen_independent_per_required_cell_bas: record count passing the eight frozen digest and normalised-template axes. It is NOT a count of independent semantic archetypes; see independence_design.measured_by_packet_r3, which measures 5 archetypes per cell against a protocol minimum of 15.
coverage.protocol_source_caveat: origin/coordination/swarm-control was unreachable from this worker environment, so the protocol constants were taken from the in-repo restatement. If the coordination branch says otherwise, the coordination branch wins and this freeze needs a correction.
coverage.auxiliary_policy: the v2 corpus holds required cells only. Auxiliary families are out of scope for this freeze and are not folded into any required cell, because merging several task types into one qualification cell lets a strong sub-type mask a weak one.

independence_design.r2_claim_now_withdrawn: R2 claimed that within one cell the fifteen inputs differ on two independent axes at once, so that neither of two inputs in a cell is a re-skin of the other. R3 measured the corpus and that claim is false. It is withdrawn.

measured_by_packet_r3.method: grep over the committed shards for the variant field, the scenario field and literal clause text; counts below are exact and reproducible with the commands in provenance_commands_executed
measured_by_packet_r3.archetype_key: the record's variant field; each of the 20 variants occurs exactly 12 times
how_the_other_ten_records_in_a_cell_are_: scenario-name substitution: the same archetype re-emitted under a different scenario noun, which the packet protocol explicitly refuses to count as independent
cumulative clause growth: the larger record's items list is a literal prefix-extension of the smaller record's items list
literal_clause_sharing_examples: the coding clause 'returns an empty dict for an empty input list' occurs in 3 records in each of coding_S, coding_M, coding_L and coding_XL, so 12 records share it
the reasoning evidence line 'station A1 recorded 43 units in cycle 1' occurs in 9 records in each of the four reasoning shards, so 36 of the 60 reasoning records share it
measured_by_packet_r3.why_the_frozen_checker_does_not_catch_th: g13-independence-checker-v2 normalises synthetic identifiers and digit runs, so it catches seed-isomorphic siblings of equal arity. A scenario-name substitution changes a lower-case noun, which normalisation preserves, and a cumulative clause variant changes the arity, so both survive every one of the eight frozen axes. Catching them needs a semantic-archetype axis that this freeze version does not have.

B7 - OPEN AND BLOCKING, raised by R3: each required cell holds 5 distinct semantic archetypes, not the 15 the protocol requires. The remaining 10 records per cell are scenario-name substitutions and cumulative clause variants of those 5, which the packet protocol refuses to count as independent. A Wilson bound over 15 records per cell therefore still overstates confidence, which is the same defect class as v1 blocker B3 at a level the frozen checker cannot see. Closing B7 requires a re-minted corpus with 240 distinct archetypes plus a new checker id and freeze version; R3 could not author it because Python execution was denied and a blind re-mint could not be verified.

B8 - OPEN, raised by R3: GitHub Actions run 35587202715 reports an offline pytest failure at the exact tip 6467552f86e40964e5bd26d85e3b3a74d03aa059. R3 could not reproduce it: pytest, python and uv are all denied in this worker environment, and origin/coordination/swarm-control could not be fetched to read the run log. The failing test and its cause are therefore unidentified, and no fix for it is claimed.
